sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: Computers and communications in 2019: opening paragraph

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: A circa-$1,000 consumer budget, inflation-adjusted from 1999, buys approximately 20 petaflops of ordinary arithmetic capacity.
reference.rationale: Consumer hardware in 2019 was orders of magnitude below 20 petaflops in conventional FP32 throughput. Current checked consumer GPU specifications remain far short on that basis. Inflation adjustment and GPU-only accounting do not rescue the order-of-magnitude mismatch.

evidence.title: NVIDIA: RTX 30-series launch specifications and pricing

evidence.note: 10,752 CUDA cores, 2.62 GHz boost; theoretical FP32 about 56.3 TFLOPS using 2 operations/core/cycle.
